rows.explainer: What people reached by disaster relief consume over the year, as a share of their country's household-survey mean. Relief targets the worst-affected and poorest, about the poorest 40%, whose mean is 0.30 to 0.55 of the survey mean in Mozambique, Bangladesh, Brazil and Myanmar. A year's consumption is the base, not the short dip right after the disaster, since relief is counted against a year. 0.42, from 0.28 to 0.7.
